intentional_differences: Read-only native paragraph projection; the caller supplies assistant paragraphs after separating fenced blocks.
Unexpected backtick or tilde fences preserve the entire input as text; no second whole-transcript fence engine.
Local paths retain spelling and relative/home identity; no workspace resolution, URL loading, filesystem probes, containment decisions or network requests.
Only explicit ./, ../ and ~/ relative Markdown paths qualify; bare relative Markdown URLs stay text. Standalone @file ref_text can name bare relative paths.
Complete quoted and angle-wrapped MEDIA paths are accepted. Unquoted paths end at whitespace; ambiguous spaced filenames require delimiters.
Remote HTTP, custom, sandbox, data, javascript and protocol-relative destinations remain text. File URLs require an empty or localhost host and no credentials, port, query or fragment.
All file types can become cards; extension-based MIME and basename are display metadata. Unknown MIME is application/octet-stream.
Intentional repeated placements stay ordered; ChatAttachment identity is the full server path.
Malformed Markdown or delimited MEDIA values preserve the remainder of their line; incomplete backtick spans preserve the remainder of input.
unsupported_forms: Reference-style or multiline Markdown links/images and autolinks
Bare relative Markdown URLs such as assets/report.pdf
MEDIA paths with a whitespace gap after the colon, emphasis wrappers or ambiguous unquoted spaces
Host inference, workspace/home expansion, Markdown line/column suffix interpretation and filesystem existence checks
Actual artifact downloads and preview presentation
license: Hermex syntax/delimiter attribution is retained in source and tests; full MIT notice already exists in LICENSES/Hermex.txt.
